designBrief: Square navy launcher icon showing an illustrative three-quarter isometric academic hall: a horizontal white elevated bar, narrow vertical windows, a dark blue glazed end, open pilotis, a lower block and broad forecourt stair. Muted blue plinth, restrained depth, no text, official seal, university signature, location pin, green or gold.

architecturalBasis.limitation: A simplified original icon inspired by documented architectural features, not a measured reconstruction or a photograph of the building.
